name: rtc-realtime-chat
description: Real-Time Chat System — run frontend + backend together

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
